[Unit]

User=mover
Group=mover

EnvironmentFile=/run/fm-sd-1.service.env
SyslogIdentifier=fm-sd-1.service
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -eu -c 'true'
ExecStart=/tmp/qualification-debug /tmp/local/runtime-debug-copy_chunk-shutdown-2-sd-1-2exports/config.json

Restart=on-failure

CapabilityBoundingSet=
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077
PrivateTmp=no
